evals.prompt: Turn the plan we just wrote into something I can review visually with diagrams and open questions.
evals.expected_output: Produces the structured visual plan (plan.mdx or equivalent) from the existing text plan as source - not a rewrite from scratch, not a chat paragraph.
expectations: Existing plan used as source material
Output is the structured reviewable artifact with diagrams/questions
Actual plan URL appears in chat as the handoff, not just an opened preview

evals.prompt: We need to align on the dashboard redesign - three possible layouts, lots of open questions.

expectations: Options and open questions rendered as structured blocks
